rationale: The compiled shared-artifact world satisfies the four trusted structural capabilities and can support a narrow assigned evidence-check-text contrast on correct manifest publication. The current proposal also claims independent task completion, wait/resume dependency fidelity and verifier-confirmed completion that its actions and oracle do not implement. Its initial public message exposes reminder-intervention purpose to every role and is a verification rule rather than an unsupported completion assertion. Correct the source wording and narrow the measurement/mechanism before requesting a new bound review; do not approve the unchanged proposal or infer an effect direction.
source_misstatements: Observed fact 1: message70099418-7678-4ee9-9f1d-10f3ae575527 asks o3 whether the graph was published and describes its prospective value to GPT-4.1's draft; it does not report Claude3.7 updating that draft or completing the asserted next-action sequence.

Observed fact 2: messages9a863ed2-0340-4aa0-9c3c-4bf54eed6b3e and492ea55a-a5b9-49a1-ae00-26242b55561b support a reported dependency and later claimed update. Actual artifact availability, edit correctness, task completion and a causal dependency chain are not independently established by those chat reports.
required_changes: Scope the question, mechanism and inventions to assigned private evidence-check text and executed correct manifest publication. Remove independent-task-completion and latent stale-state-reduction claims unless a different operationalized world is separately authored and reviewed.

Describe wait as a budget-consuming legal action, not a once-only wait/resume affordance or an artifact-availability release process. The artifact exists at reset and the world has no resume action or gated dependent task.

Replace the public completion_claim with an explicitly invented previous-shift completion assertion that does not mention reminder interventions, treatment timing or an enforced verifier-confirmation condition. Preserve its status as unverified subject-visible source text.

Define primary success as exact correctness of a published manifest; label inspections and inspected_publication as executed process measures. Any-role current-version inspection is not verifier confirmation, correct mental verification or a causal mediator.
Rewrite observed facts as actor-specific reports/plans and later claimed updates. Keep source identity/membership distinct from semantic truth and historical identification.

Document the real predefined contrast: coordinator private evidence-check note versus matched neutral note immediately before its first scheduled decision; baseline is additional. The note is not authored as a generic reminder that a depended-on artifact may be unavailable.

Create an explicitly amended blueprint with a new hash and a new supplied/model fit review. Preserve the failed original attempt and capped reviewer record; do not mutate them or represent this supplied review as the missing hosted reviewer response.
limitations: This is a separately supplied methodological review by a development subagent, not completion of the capped hosted reviewer, independent institutional/model adjudication or a provider result.
Read-only inspection authenticated exact local registry object hashes and read normalized imported messages; it did not freshly reread raw chat archives, browser artifacts or sessions.
The four trusted capabilities are structurally supported; missing_capabilities is empty because the broader semantic affordances were not in that declared capability list.
CPU witnesses check legal transitions/oracle semantics only. No subjects, model calls, registry writes, protocol registration or causal comparison were performed.
Historical waiting duration, independent-work opportunities, network mediation, beliefs, memory and unavailable-artifact dynamics remain unmodeled.
A later narrowed synthetic study can yield improvement, null or harm; no effect direction, mechanism identification or generalization is certified.
